New protocol: everyone in a session needs 0.9.2 (it doesn't play with 0.9.1)
Friends see missiles, Fat Man shots, shells and explosive rounds fly; each still explodes once
Power armor frames no longer duplicate: a load now removes every copy the mod placed, so none ends up in your save
Fixed a crash when loading a save twice in one run; an older save with a leftover says so (save, restart, play from the new save)
Every explosion hits once, and a friend's shots no longer hit you on your screen
Enemies match in every game (legendaries, settlers vs scavengers), and hits are no longer healed back after a takeover
Doors, traps, mines, cars, barrels and knocked-about objects are shared
A friend's power armor can't be entered or looted yet; borrowing comes later
A friend in a DLC area you don't own shows as out of reach
Settlers take jobs in a session; a scrapped dropped item no longer comes back
The host can allow more than 4 players (iMaxPlayers)
Full notes on GitHub
